Rafael / Marissa —

Proposed benchmark plan (summary) — I’ll run the detailed scripts and provide a full runbook before we schedule the full pass. High level:

1) Infra baseline
- Run on Redwood Dedicated (NVIDIA H100 80GB, mixed int8/FP16 quant profiles available). Default model: open-variant v3.2 (8-bit quant for throughput runs; FP16 for latency-sensitive runs).

2) Workload definition (samples attached):
- Short prompts (<=128 tokens): 50% of requests (UI quick queries)
- Medium prompts (256 tokens): 30%
- Long prompts (1024 tokens): 20%
- Mix includes a 15% subset of requests which exercise heavy system messages + example-based instruction-following (to simulate generation-heavy paths).

3) Measurement methods
- TTFT: measured at client-side timestamp of request dispatch -> first-token arrival at client. We'll run both "cold" (first request after idle) and "steady" (after warmup, with KV-cache optimizations). Report p50, p95, p99.
- Token latency: per-token time reported as the time between receiving token N and N+1 averaged across responses (p50/p95).
- Throughput: tokens/sec aggregated across GPUs; report effective tokens/sec per GPU and aggregate.

4) Concurrency sweep
- Run at target concurrency points: 2, 5, 10, 15, 25, 40. For each point measure TTFT distributions and overall throughput.

5) Success criteria (pass):
- Short prompts: TTFT p95 <= 250ms (Bluepeak requirement)
- Overall p95 token latency <= 150ms for short prompts, <= 400ms for long prompts (1024 tokens)
- Sustained aggregate throughput meets or exceeds 75% of the modeled production demand at peak (we’ll convert expected per-user token needs into tokens/sec; need Bluepeak’s projected TP/sec — Olivia, can you share?)
- No regressions vs baseline model beyond 5% for quality metrics (we’ll watch basic automated rubric accuracy and hallucination counts).

6) Estimated run time
- Full sweep (all concurrency points, warmups) ~ 6–8 hours (non-blocking, can be parallelized across nodes).

7) Artifacts we will provide
- Raw logs + aggregate plots (TTFT distribution, throughput chart, per-concurrency table)
- CSV test-results-template.csv for reproducible runs
- Acceptance checklist with explicit PASS/FAIL flags

I'll prepare the runbook and test-schedule.md. If Bluepeak needs VPC/private testing we can mirror the same plan into their VPC, but that requires a short onboarding window (network allowlist + keys).

Karthik
